bb_the_fee_explained.description: Nizzik is putting the landing fee up on the Ratchet boat specifically, by order, with a date, and she has been told to expect the small hulls to start beaching on the sand east of the cape rather than come up the ramp and pay. They already have. Bloodsail bosuns are taking a cut off every keel that lands there, which means the dodgers are paying a worse toll to a worse collector, and Nizzik finds that funnier than she should.
bb_the_fee_explained.accept_text:
Up a silver on the Ratchet run from the first tide of next month. Not my decision and I would have made the same one. The ones dodging it are beaching on the shallows and handing the difference to a bosun with a knife, which is the market working. Go and break that up anyway. Walk the beach track while you are down there so the carters can see it being walked.

The Bloodsail Shallows are east of our gate, along the south shore.

bb_stoneshapers.accept_text:
Two silver for where to look, and you pay first, because I am eleven and not stupid. Great court, the big flat one with the steps. There is a crew in there cutting stone and one of them stands back and says a number and the rest of them cut to it. Go and stand in that court and look at the faces they are cutting, then come back, because if it is true I am selling it to the Baron and I need somebody grown to have seen it.

Zul'Kundaraz. North-east of the Bay, up in the hills, and it is a long walk even for somebody grown.
